name: University of Primorska
summary: Public university on the Adriatic coast, founded 2003, about 5,900 students (a quarter international); ten bachelor's offered in English.

handoff.label: Study programmes in English (bachelor's and more)

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as a Slovenian general matura with no recognition step, and the IB result stands in for school years 3–4 in the ranking. The IB certificate alone needs recognition.

apply.via: eVŠ national portal (joint call for enrolment)

programmes.name: Anthropology
programmes.about: Double-discipline degree (180 ECTS) in the Faculty of Humanities: fieldwork, participant observation and research methods for understanding societies and cultures, from Slovenia and the Mediterranean to the Americas.
programmes.ib: Double-discipline: you choose two programmes (or a programme and a module) on the same application; the English version runs alongside a Slovene one.
programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 70% overall IB result converted to the Slovenian scale, 30% school years 3–4 (the IB result counts for both). 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Cultural Heritage
programmes.about: Double-discipline degree (180 ECTS) drawing on archaeology, art history, ethnology, architecture and history, with practical and field work on tangible and intangible heritage.
programmes.ib: Double-discipline: combined with another programme on the same application; places are listed separately for the English and Slovene versions.
programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 70% overall IB result converted to the Slovenian scale, 30% school years 3–4 (the IB result counts for both). 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Management
programmes.about: Theory-led degree (180 ECTS, 32 courses) combining business and economics at the Faculty of Management in Koper, delivered in English and aimed at postgraduate study or management roles.
programmes.ib: B2 English must be proved with a certificate; a school-leaving certificate showing English as a subject also counts.
programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 60% overall IB result converted to the Slovenian scale, 40% school years 3–4 (the IB result counts for both). 2026/27 rules.

programmes.name: Bioinformatics
programmes.about: Biology, chemistry, physics and genetics combined with mathematics and computer science, for analysing data and modelling biological systems. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper and Izola.
programmes.ib: B2 English may be asked for; Slovenian or English version chosen when you apply.
programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 70% overall IB result converted to the Slovenian scale, 30% school years 3–4 (the IB result counts for both). 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Programming languages, development tools and software-building methods, with analytical thinking for ICT systems. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper.
programmes.ib: B2 English may be asked for; Slovenian or English version chosen when you apply.

needs.note: Scored, not a minimum: maths grades of school years 3–4 are 20% of the points

programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 50% overall IB result converted, 30% school years 3–4, 20% maths grades of years 3–4. 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Mathematics and Computer Science
separateFrom.reason: Different degrees with different selection formulas (maths counts 20% against 40%) and their own places.

programmes.name: Mathematics
programmes.about: Analysis, algebra, discrete mathematics and numerical computation in year one, then electives in theoretical and applied mathematics. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper.
programmes.ib: B2 English may be asked for; Slovenian or English version chosen when you apply.

needs.note: Scored, not a minimum: maths grades of school years 3–4 are 40% of the points

programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 40% overall IB result converted, 20% school years 3–4, 40% maths grades of years 3–4. 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Mathematics and Computer Science
separateFrom.reason: Different degrees with their own programme pages; both weigh maths grades at 40%, but places and content differ.

programmes.name: Mathematics and Computer Science
programmes.about: Mathematical foundations (analysis, algebra) combined with computer science, leading into data science, machine learning and information security. Three years (180 ECTS) in Koper.
programmes.ib: B2 English may be asked for; Slovenian or English version chosen when you apply.

needs.note: Scored, not a minimum: maths grades of school years 3–4 are 40% of the points

programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 40% overall IB result converted, 20% school years 3–4, 40% maths grades of years 3–4. 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Computer Science
separateFrom.reason: Different degrees with different selection formulas (maths counts 20% against 40%) and their own places.

separateFrom.name: Mathematics
separateFrom.reason: Different degrees with their own programme pages; both weigh maths grades at 40%, but places and content differ.

programmes.name: Wood Innovation for Sustainability
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Applied Science in Wood Engineering
programmes.about: Professional degree (180 ECTS) joining natural science and engineering with wood properties, manufacturing and circular bioeconomy, plus digitalisation, data analytics and AI in the wood sector.
programmes.ib: B2 English may be asked for; Slovenian or English version chosen when you apply.
programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 60% overall IB result converted, 40% school years 3–4 (the IB result counts for both). 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Tourism Destination Management
programmes.about: Professional programme training managers of tourism organisations and complex tourism processes, taught by the Faculty of Tourism Studies Turistica in Ljubljana as part-time study.
programmes.ib: Business English at B2 is required; the page also recommends a second foreign language (Italian or German) at A1–A2.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission needs a general or vocational matura, so the IB Diploma qualifies; the selection formula is in the annual call. 2026/27 places shown.

separateFrom.name: Tourism Enterprise Management
separateFrom.reason: Different programmes at different campuses: destination management in Ljubljana, enterprise management in Portorož.

programmes.name: Tourism Enterprise Management
programmes.about: Tourism markets, marketing, economics, languages and the business and organisation of tourism firms; taught in English in Portorož by the Faculty of Tourism Studies Turistica.
programmes.ib: The page calls the English programme part-time and fee-paying; the places table also lists 20 full-time English places, so ask the faculty which applies.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission needs a general or vocational matura, so the IB Diploma qualifies; the selection formula is in the annual call. 2026/27 places shown.

separateFrom.name: Tourism Destination Management
separateFrom.reason: Different programmes at different campuses: destination management in Ljubljana, enterprise management in Portorož.

notes: Full-time study is free for EU citizens at UP; the two tourism degrees are part-time and fee-paying for everyone.
Anthropology and Cultural Heritage are double-discipline: you pick two programmes (or a programme plus a module) on one application.
The 2026/27 call lists English and Slovene versions of the same degree as separate rows with their own places; apply to the English row.
